scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Transform without collapsing occurrences or unknowns
cases.input_contract: Keep rows whose amount is nonnegative orNULL, then return entity_id, segment, doubled=amount*2. Preserve duplicate occurrences and unknown values.
cases.expected: Seven rows, known total 130 and oneNULL doubled value. The negative entity 6 row is excluded.
cases.verification: Assert population, total and unknown count, then compare with the literal golden relation in later tasks.

cases.title: Define an ordered field/type contract
cases.input_contract: Return ordered(name, simple_type) pairs from the result schema. Compare with entity_id bigint, segment string, doubled bigint.
cases.expected: Exactly those three fields in that order. Casting entity_id to string changes the contract even when printed values look alike.
cases.verification: Assert the correct type list and a different list after the deliberate cast.

cases.title: Compare schemas before duplicate-sensitive values
cases.input_contract: Reject a schema mismatch first, then require both exceptAll differences to be empty. Accept a repartitioned correct result and reject the deliberate string-ID result.
cases.expected: Correct result passes in different physical layouts;string-ID candidate fails with a named schema contract error.
cases.verification: Assert acceptance for golden/repartitioned values and explicit schema rejection before a coercing bag comparison.

cases.title: Register, materialize, reuse and release one cached relation
cases.input_contract: Persist the supplied transformed relation with MEMORY_AND_DISK, materialize via count, reuse for a total and inspect a filtered consumer plan. Unpersist with blocking cleanup in finally.
cases.expected: Count 7, total 130, an InMemoryTableScan reuse marker, and no registered storage level after return.
cases.verification: Assert result values, cache-scan evidence and post-returnStorageLevel.NONE. Do not use a timing threshold.

cases.title: Release persistence when a consumer fails
cases.input_contract: Persist and materialize the relation, then raise an injected failure before a later consumer. Unpersist in finally and verify the original error reaches the caller.
cases.expected: The injected_after_materialize error is observed and storage level isNONE afterward. Correct uncached output still passes the golden oracle.
cases.verification: Assert the named failure, post-failure release and full golden equality on a subsequent computation.

cases.title: Demonstrate why set equality misses duplicate loss
cases.input_contract: Return directional exceptAll row counts after schema validation. Compare transformed.distinct with golden and require the golden validator to reject it.
cases.expected: Distinct has 5 rows;unexpected occurrences 0 and missing expected occurrences 2. The bag validator raises a named bag contract mismatch.
cases.verification: Assert(0,2), count 5 and the explicit negative-control rejection.
